13Z Demo Hotfix \[v0.7.0.876]
While we’re working on some bigger updates in the background, we’re also chipping away at optimizations and other small QoL fixes.

Tutorial's graphical performance has been further optimized.

Mouse look sensitivity now can be adjusted on a much wider range.

Reduced controller vibration when Perfect Dodge is executed.

Some causes of FPS drop in the Goat fight in tutorial has been fixed.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes [0.7.0.872]
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/0ca78412b7ce56af8b6982e35e43e8e4ae6fdff9.png"]

Hi Zodiac Challengers! Thanks to your sharp eyes, we’ve been able to tackle more performance & memory optimizations, polish combat flow, and add a few community-inspired touches. This update focuses on smoother play, key balance changes, and important bug fixes.

Have you noticed smoother performance and fewer memory issues since the patch? We’d love to hear your experience. :)[hr][/hr]
VERSION 0.7.0.872 (SEP 4, 2025)


All items with * were inspired by the Community. Thank you!

General and QoL Updates
Further optimized memory usage and reduced memory leak scenarios, especially in boss fights \[ongoing effort].*

Added Fairy Peach as a possible reward in combat encounters.*

Further improvements to jump and fall responsiveness.*

Added a background framerate option in graphics settings.*
Balancing Changes*
Sylith’s (Raven) ranged light attack damage slightly reduced

Blightlight’s fireball damage: 50 → 30

Specturn’s mortar damage: 50 → 40, self-explosion: 10 → 70

Coinlets’ tongue lash damage: 50 → 15, bubble damage: 10 → 5

Sporelings’ explosion damage: 1 → 15

Sporebloomer’s self-explosion damage: 10 → 80

Sporebasher’s head bash damage: 50 → 35

Sporeblade’s spin damage: 50 → 30

Sporepuffer’s projectile hitbox adjusted for accuracy

Sporelobber’s bomb damage: 50 → 75

Ember Vanguard’s (Fire Golem) parts now have increased HP

Stone pillar fall damage fixed at 100

Mountain Technique seals bonus damage: 70% → 40%

Heaven base crit damage multiplier: 150% → 200%

Various Thunder upgrades that utilize Bolt had their damage increased up to 100%.
Bug Fixes
Patch notes window now scrolls properly on first visit

Sylith’s hair now shows the correct blue highlights

Sylith’s special Daggerstorm now appears properly in all boss fights*

Sporebasher’s danger indicator now displays as intended

In the Ember Vanguard fight, players will no longer be blasted away unexpectedly

Stronghold at the end of Act 1 Stage 3 now spawns chests correctly

Water Special (Chilling Infusion) now applies the correct bonus damage

Fairy Peaches can now be stacked properly when consumed multiple times in a trial.

Static requirements of Thunder upgrades now correctly reduce with higher levels.



Crafted with Love, 

Mixed Realms Team



You can find us on: 

Discord / X (Twitter) / Tiktok / Youtube / Reddit

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #01
notes.content:
Hey Zodiac Challengers, If you’re late to the news... yes, the DEMO is live! It’s packed with improvements from Playtests 1 and 2, plus a sneak peek of Act 2 in the form of a brand-new biome: the vast desert.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/67580e31f806c2e50ae71772fd33b8145ccb5ba6.png"]

It’s only been a week since the demo launched, and you’ve already kept us busy with your sharp eyes and quick reflexes. From bug reports to balance notes (and even a few wild combos we didn’t see coming), you’ve helped us tune the Trials.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/5f8111eeb4e86a83ce55e2fcb91d47795fe51974.png"]

Today we’re serving up the first batch of fixes and updates, focused on the most common issues you raised during Week 1. Think of it as a taste test, as the Pig might say, before the main feast. More tweaks and a few surprises are already simmering for the next update. 🙂


Floaty jumps? We hear you loud and clear.
Not something we're proud of but it seems we changed some values in the code by accident, leading to floaty falls from jumps. 
Share with us what you think about this change after trying the new build so we know whether we're on the right path.

notes.title: What We Learned from Playtest 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/40d27e6c53eb6980a0ae98dffa9916eb8b92f2d2.png
Hey Zodiac Challengers! We’ve been meaning to put this post together a little sooner, but honestly... you gave us a lot to chew on. We received thousands of comments and feedback after Playtest 2 across Discord and our socials. So we took our time—reading, re-reading, digesting, and discussing as a team.

Now that the dust has settled a little, we’re back with a quick roundup of everything you helped shape.

Playtest 2 Highlights
Let’s kick things off with a look back! We put together a short highlight reel featuring some of our favorite moments from the community during Playtest 2, everything from epic plays to unexpected chaos.

[previewyoutube=7OUf4x6BRTQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We couldn’t fit every single clip (we tried… our dev-editor said NO😅), but we’re grateful for all of you who participated, streamed, shared, and supported us throughout the playtest.

What We Learned from Playtest 2
After sorting through all the feedback, here are some of the biggest takeaways:

You Liked the Art
The visual improvements from Playtest 1 were a hit—most of you gave us an 8 to 10 out of 10! We’re especially glad to hear you liked the new water physics and added environmental details. We’ll continue leveling this up as we build out new areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/391c1112998ec43e1342d365c2763e07193f60ea.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/18d71f6386a351fd1841eb80653da7cce0615f75.png

Combat Pacing Feedback
While Act 2 introduced new moves and refinements, some of you missed the faster, more fluid pacing from Playtest 1. Good news: we’re already working to bring that energy back. Some of the slight slow down also came from bugs (like fox form transforming mid-dash), and those are on our radar too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/fb853962dd2d9b26a27d202c8917e5528c9f1ad7.gif
We're bringing this speed back!

The Systems You Liked
The Monkey’s Challenges, cultivation tree upgrades, and expanded elemental options also received positive feedback (of course, with some plans for more balance tweaks!). Many of you enjoyed how these systems encouraged experimentation and noticed the more obvious elemental synergies between elements compared to the earlier versions. Expect more polish and impact in future versions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/0f60fdae0f1ca0ebb26ee91dcf1015d83d5e02af.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/5f9d8a0ea7fc45a4f62aaa407221be71ddbc62e1.png

Performance & Optimization
With all the new content and visual upgrades in Playtest 2, performance did take a bit of a hit. We’re aware of the occasional stutters and high GPU usage especially on lower-end machines. Once content development stabilizes, we’ll be dedicating more attention to making things smooth again. 

For example, we're optimizing models and textures to reduce drawcalls. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/a354420d4a2ea1f6c18f6e1b2a1a04e3338e8b1a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/a7fdd24f5458c55af08afd81d3ebbeff56f2f67d.png

…and more!
We're working on bringing the Anvils from Playtest 1 which many of you missed. The Cultivation Tree is also growing, with more branches and upgrades on the way. We’re tackling enemy readability, balance tweaks, collider clean-up, and more. It’s going to be a busy few months, but we’ll keep you updated.

🔮 What’s Next?
We’re actively working on everything we just talked about: your feedback, bug fixes, performance improvements, and new content. Some of you might’ve spotted our early desert previews... yes, the sand’s still looking stiff, but give us time! We’re hoping to bring it up to the same level as our beloved water physics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/afd58245d6ad5132a6d9c7ff2d842870d63398c2.gif
Yeah, it still looks ugly *for now*. 

🎨 Fanart Appreciation
We’ve received some fantastic fanart over the past few months, and we’ve been quietly collecting each and every piece. It means a lot to see our characters brought to life in your own styles.

@Astélie | IG: @ast3li3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/85ee5da8b4102361be5054fb183f1ca490574b55.png

--

@astralinfernal | Bluesky: @astralinferno.bsky.social
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/cfc1dae3c827b93d4dca815c755b9019fd7043b6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/8da4a32947d7ac4b5eef3f3eee36e6b3ad61a5a9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/33d5f72c24fad71a54bd0529a65d82f4b0f5d444.png

And hey... a little trivia: Sylith’s getting a visual update SOON. 👀 
Thanks again for being part of this journey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/d6c5706ba0daca684ce127fd6d6768c4d23be1b7.png
💬 Let's Chat! 

Find us on Twitter | Tiktok | Youtube | Discord

notes.title: Playtest Extended, Exclusive Rewards for Playtesters, and Fanart Fun!
notes.content:
Hey Zodiac Challengers! First things first: HUGE THANKS for joining us in Playtest 2! We're stoked to welcome so many new challengers into the 13Z community and to see all your amazing feedback (some of you even writing entire essays into the official feedback form - we're loving every word! ^____^). Keep 'em coming!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/e40f800db457a5b4bbddc2d0764c33fad239e69c.png

Playtest 2 Extended!
Good news: we're extending Playtest 2 until April 21st! After the recent performance update, we've received messages from new players who were worried they'd miss their chance to finally jump in. Additionally, since co-op won't return for a while as we refocus our efforts on enhancing the single-player experience, we wanted to give everyone extra time to fully enjoy teaming up with friends.

✨Special Cosmetic Item Incoming!✨
Many of you asked if we're cooking up something special for our amazing playtesters and we mentioned that we needed to build a proper backend system for it. Well, surprise! Everyone who participated in Playtest 2 will receive an exclusive cosmetic item at the full game launch. We’ll share some previews on Discord in due time so stay tuned! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/2876575963e8948f81b093e43dc7e7b82e3f9593.gif

Join Our Community Gameplay Highlight Reel!
As 13Z’s Playtest 2 wraps on April 21st, we want to celebrate with you. We’d love to put together a community highlight reel, and if you're a content creator who made a video, we’d love to feature a snippet. If you've made content for 13Z's Playtest 2, share your link on Discord, below in the comments, or DM us on Twitter. Include your handle so we can credit you. We'll feature around 15 clips, so bring your best / funniest / most memorable moments!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/706f68f44592467c952bb915ff1c53cd4ca9f08e.jpg

Thanks for being an incredible community. Keep the creativity and feedback flowing!

notes.title: 13Z Global Playtest 2 is LIVE: Co-op, New Challenger, and More!
notes.content:
Hey Zodiac Challengers, the wait is finally over... our mega playtest update has arrived!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/ef4911ccd7f32057a02c6ccce6be1c140e220d36.png

As always, we'd like to start with a huge thank you to everyone who participated in the first playtest. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us refine 13Z: The Zodiac Trials. We’ve been hard at work polishing mechanics, fixing bugs and adding new content.

This update brings co-op mode, a new playable character, more elemental powers, and even a glimpse of some of the Zodiac Guardians who will play a bigger role in the full game. 

The 13Z Global Playtest 2 will be available to the public from March 04 to April 06, 2025.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/1c6944cce5e7f6aa4ff5c7024814b5480290ac18.png

⚠️ Playtest Reminder – Work in Progress! ⚠️
Before we dive in, a quick reminder—this is still a playtest, NOT the final version. Our goal is to share our progress with the community and improve the game based on your feedback.

Expect bugs, the occasional frame drops, and some placeholder assets, but rest assured, we’ve put together a solid build for you to enjoy. We've also compiled a list of FAQs and Known Issues at the end of this post and are always happy to address any issues or answer your questions on our Discord. :)

Now, let’s talk about the exciting part!

[previewyoutube=omCSzXmlU4s;full][/previewyoutube]

🏆 Co-op is Here – Team Up for the Trials!

The much-awaited 2-4P co-op is finally live! Now, you don’t have to take on the Zodiac Trials alone—bring your friends and conquer the challenges together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/e917968515547ab46059cca576b66e2462a410ec.gif

How to Access Co-op:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/fc4ce502c72725bc7462f8a05b4f79f78d1e3477.png

 Co-op becomes available after your first visit to the village following your initial solo trial run.
 Activate it via the pause menu—you can create or join a team.
 Since we’re still testing the servers, we recommend playing with friends from the same region for a smoother experience.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/08a748eddb1aa5beddd2cc4108b6c92ba0d5499e.png
Play Together, Shape the Run
Synergize your abilities – Find your role in the chaos! Whether you focus on damage, control, or defense, your team composition can change the course of each run.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/f0bc01882b193fb631c14e75a7c19cb26387ec8e.gif

Make collective choices – As a team, you’ll vote on some of the rewards and challenges that affect the whole team, shaping your journey through the Trials.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/28eee0bb734440ba1b9d623b505871c92aaf80ab.gif

The Zodiac Trials weren’t meant to be easy, but with allies by your side, you might just make it through in one piece!

 🐦‍⬛New Challenger: Sylith the Raven
A new challenger takes flight—Sylith the Raven is finally leaving his cozy perch on the Teahouse rooftop and diving headfirst into the Trials! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/188b8d8aebe1c7b39227b815de34b641d1084149.png

After completing a few runs with Lyra as your starting character, you’ll unlock this elusive ranged fighter, whose mastery of flying daggers and aerial maneuvers lets him strike from a distance while staying one step ahead of his enemies.

Now, let’s take a closer look at his key abilities.

Primary Attack – A rapid series of dagger throws. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/21047e65399ea8b62ccf99c37975088fd6249ebe.gif

Secondary Attack – Conjure a spectral raven that bounces between enemies for extra hits.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/8209d8c7c68e490db684f5aed8dfb6ff91b6a3e0.gif

Special Move – Unleash a storm of daggers from above, covering the battlefield.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/432e9ac46bd66fa5330d5fddcf1db626c11c8379.gif

If you prefer keeping enemies at a distance, Sylith is your guy.

🦊 Lyra Unlocks a New Martial Arts Style
Lyra isn’t about to let Sylith steal the spotlight—she’s stepping up her game with a new weapon that unlocks an entirely different Martial Arts Style. Once unlocked, you can swap weapons at the Armory near the Trial Gates in Turtle Village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/9b20a54fcb492a67a68a3477d328f2ee3e8d5c1b.png

Her default sword, Ruby Shadow, still delivers the crisp, fluid strikes you know and love.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/e1a3e71f2c7ffd70f97468bad3a339c39f723c85.gif

But if you’re looking to expand her arsenal, unlocking her Ethereal Sting sword at the Armory grants access to Phantom Dancer, a new Martial Arts Style that introduces spectral-infused attacks with a focus on speed and precision.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/55efa21d811dd115c8f8dfb3ce05ad2b3872eaf2.png

Some of her new abilities include:
Spinning Thrust – A spiraling charge attack that cuts through enemies in her path.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/6c26f4dff22ea0b8a657ed0ed50fb43c58ede642.gif

Spectral Piercing Strikes – A flurry of ghostly sword thrusts, delivering rapid, precise damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/555cbe49967985bc4d09cbe91144440cfa8144bb.gif

With Phantom Dancer, Lyra can shift between physical and spectral techniques, adding a whole new layer of versatility to her combat style.

🌌 New Elements & Synergies
Elemental Upgrades were a hit in the first playtest, and now we’re expanding the system with two new elements, more upgrades and synergies that combine their effects in creative ways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/de945baff0e3a1b75cd670b796800afd1ab46454.png

A Quick Breakdown of Elements available in this Playtest:

 Heaven – Increases Critical Damage & Bonuses.
 Mountain – Boosts Armor & Stuns enemies.
 Fire – Deals Burn & Damage Over Time.
 Water – Slows enemies or Freezes them.
 Lightning – Chains damage between enemies.


🌟 Synergies – Unleash Devastating Effects!
When two elements combine, they create a powerful passive effect. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/f22f9ae429c821686d3a68cec3e2eee79bbd9f1f.png

Here’s an example: Mountain + Fire = Meteor Crash: A fiery meteor descends upon enemies affected by Stun and Burn, dealing massive damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/e0e2a30c69c51efe09c97a1c8ba27baa71c511ba.gif

There are more synergies to discover, so experiment and find your ultimate elemental combo!

🎨 Improved Environments & Visual Upgrades
The world of 13Z is coming to life with more graphical improvements:
✔ More detailed levels with enhanced textures.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/85ce6dbb9d07ba97645ba609acb07ed795ce9020.png

✔ Better water physics— water features now react to movement.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/e2da9d333917e374446eb92436d80fc74028fd7c.gif

✔ Lighting and atmospheric tweaks to improve immersion.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/34bd968a7fdd0ab81d66decce3b7b7261a363f75.gif

While we’re still polishing things up, these upgrades bring more depth and atmosphere to the Zodiac Trials.

Meet More Zodiac Guardians
While the Zodiac Guardians have mostly watched from the sidelines, this playtest lets you interact with more of them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/e1df2f0d78a5310d24e94dd350741d29178aebf3.png

One key figure you’ll meet is the Monkey Zodiac Guardian, the Keeper of Skill Manuals—his blessings unlock skill upgrades that will define your combat style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/bf457bb2051a2a5c0bc0d047c5c38e063bb200dd.png

Future Hint: While some Guardians offer guidance, others might not be so friendly in future updates. Better get to know them before you end up facing them in battle…

... As always, there's more!🏹
There’s plenty more to experience in this update, but the best way to discover all the changes is to jump in and play!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/d6c5706ba0daca684ce127fd6d6768c4d23be1b7.png

Don’t forget to tell your friends about 13Z—the more feedback we get, the better we can shape the game. Your support means the world to us as an indie studio, and we truly appreciate every wishlist, share, and message of encouragement.

💬 Join the Discussion & Share Your Feedback!
Drop them in our official feedback form or our Discord.

You can also find us on Twitter | Tiktok | Youtube

Crafted with Love,
Mixed Realms

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/94c29e826472f2a1dafb38ce4f74ef78c565662c.png

Frequently Asked Questions
🙋Am I allowed to stream or share my gameplay of this playtest?
Absolutely! Sharing your gameplay video not only helps us review feedback by watching your gameplay but also spreads the word about 13Z, which is a huge help to our team. Feel free to stream and post clips. :) 

🙋Until when is the playtest available?
The playtest will be open to the public from March 4 to April 6, 2025.

🙋I played Playtest 1. Will my save file carry over to Playtest 2? 
Playtest 2 brings significant changes, including new mechanics and structural updates, so progress from Playtest 1 will not carry over. In general, since we're still in the playtest phase and continuously refining the game based on feedback, save data resets are necessary to ensure a smooth experience with each iteration.

🙋Which platforms and controllers are supported? Does the game run on Steam Deck?
13Z supports keyboard + mouse, Xbox One, Xbox 360, DualShock, and DualSense controllers. Most generic controllers also work natively or via Steam Input.
As for Steam Deck, while the game runs, we haven’t done extensive testing yet so official support is still pending.

🙋I encountered a bug! Where can I report it?
The best place to report bugs is through our Discordserver, where our team can quickly respond and categorize reports based on different issues. We also added a list of known issues below with their corresponding fixes.

🙋I have suggestions and feedback! Where should I share them?
We’d love to hear your thoughts! You can submit feedback through our official feedback form (which includes a free-text entry for detailed comments) or share your ideas in the suggestions section on our Discord.

🙋When is 13Z launching?
We plan to go into Early Access first, but we don’t have a firm date yet. Hopefully this year! Be sure to wishlist and follow the game to stay updated on the latest news.

🙋Are you planning to add more languages?
Right now, we support English, Chinese, and Japanese. We’re focused on finalizing content during the playtest period, so we don’t have immediate plans to add more languages just yet.

Known Issues
⭕ Freezing at launch – We're loading a lot of things upfront to improve overall performance once the game is running—but that also means a longer startup time. To avoid crashes, please don’t click the window while the game is loading or if it looks frozen. We'll continue optimizing the game with each update.

⭕ Multiplayer Lag – Co-op may sometimes experience latency. To minimize this, we recommend playing with teammates from the same region. While server regions are usually selected automatically based on ping, manually choosing your region can improve stability.

⭕ Getting Stuck – We've swept through all colliders as thoroughly as possible. But if you find yourself stuck in a particularly tight spot (e.g. under terrain), pause the game and select "Unstuck" from the pause menu. This will return you to the map's original spawn point. If this happens, please share a screenshot in our Discord to help us investigate!

⭕Controller Issues - If your are running into issues with controller/keyboard/mouse especially during the onboarding tutorial, head to the main/pause menu->options->controls->restore default->save.

⭕ Occasional Frame Drops –  Some water-heavy areas or very flashy VFX may still cause occasional frame drops, but improvements are in progress.

⭕ Missing SFX/VFX/Assets – Certain effects and assets are placeholders and will be finalized in future updates.

⭕ Snake's Dreamland has leftover enemies – There is a 20% chance you might encounter the Snake's Dreamland challenge. A known bug sometimes leaves enemies behind, making them invulnerable to attacks. They also do not react, so you can simply collect your reward and leave. We're looking into this.

notes.title: New Playtest Update: We've just added one of your most requested features!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/189511aeedeb17f250a1395acd9f4c7bee65abf2.png

Hey Challengers! We’ve been hard at work since the playtest launched, digging through all your feedback and ideas to make 13Z even better. Today, we’re rolling out a fresh update with some key improvements—including a highly requested feature that’s sure to make battles more fluid.

Check out our devlog video that highlights everything new: 
[previewyoutube=Er0zStZVurI;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s New in the Update

Camera Lock Now Available
One of the most requested features—camera lock—has been added to the single-player playtest. Aiming and targeting should now feel much more intuitive. Try it out and let us know what you think!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/5e3af02d2d2b656ae74258893339ea572edc0a29.gif

Lyra’s Glow-Up
We’ve updated Lyra’s model, adding more expressions to bring out her personality and charm. This is just one of the many visual improvements we’ll continue refining as we move forward.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/b24cd3c7e974659aa0f7ad14d1f44c5f36fdab36.gif

Enhanced VFX and Lighting
Combat visuals have been refreshed with improved VFX, enhancing the game’s overall feedback during battles. Additionally, lighting has been given a boost, with more defined shadows. This is all part of our ongoing work to elevate the game’s visuals, and there’s more to come!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/ad55070cb92cb86d8982c942b2a62af6e2d6403c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/da79c631a299cc70278e8c492fef66474061578a.png

What’s Next?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/fd01b3b849e0f49e9876a7e88d5f34dc1a74541e.png
We’re gearing up for the next big milestone: the co-op playtest with new content! This update will not only let you team up with friends but will also introduce new mechanics and systems, including:

The Trigram Upgrade System:
Inspired by the Trigrams (bagua), upgrades will feature interconnected elements like Heaven, Lake, Fire, Lightning, Wind, Water, Mountain, and Earth. These elements will synergize in unique ways to create deeper strategies depending on how they’re unlocked in the trigram wheel. They will also linked to the Guardians serving as the main bosses in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/0611fcb46d305685866cac64ecde5b2e9abab502.png
For example: Lightning upgrades spread damage by default, but pair it with Fire upgrades, and you can chain debuffs like burn for extra devastation.

Martial Arts System (MAS):
With help from the Monkey Zodiac, you’ll soon be able to swap abilities and customize your builds. This system will work alongside the Trigram mechanics to make every run feel fresh and rewarding.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/928b35fc0b80ebe7fc2f45863aef0fe230322ce2.png

We'll cover the details and other upcoming content to watch out for in our future devlogs so stay tuned ;) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/26a24e812fbf1b1af58424c626a4f6a439f1c105.png
We’re so grateful for your support and feedback—it’s been incredible to build this game with you. If you haven’t already, wishlist 13Z on Steam and hop into the latest update to share your thoughts!

Join the discussion on Discord, where you can chat with other Challengers and share your ideas or creations. Fanart, questions, suggestions —bring it on! We’re always excited to see what the community comes up with.

Chat with us on: Discord | Twitter | Tiktok | Youtube

Thank you for being part of this adventure with us. 

Crafted with love,
Mixed Realms Team

notes.title: Devlog #03: Playtest Feedback, Sneak-Peeks and the Next Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/34a680eacf42ae2f179b413aa338aa1cd6d7cade.png

Hey Zodiac Challengers!

We've got some fun updates and news for everyone, plus a bit of what’s brewing behind the scenes since the release of the playtest.

What We’re Working On
We’re super grateful (and honestly, a bit relieved! 😌) for the positive reception since the playtest launched. It’s been amazing to see so many of you enjoying the fluidity and verticality of the combat! We’re eager to build upon what you love about the game, and we’d love for you to continue being a part of this journey with us.

With all the insights you shared, we’ve zeroed in on some key areas to improve—and, luckily, they match up perfectly with our plans. Here are a few things we’re focusing on:

Improving Level Design
We’re restructuring some rooms and making overall improvements to the size, layout and verticality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/48351b84830ff22aaf8440a371d406498747910e.png

Pacing
Coins will be rewarded upon the completion of the room rather than being distributed in random vases and pots all over the rooms. These breakable items will still have a chance to contain health drops, though.

Attack Variations & Deeper Progression
We’re working on something new and big, and will reveal the details soon… this deserves its own dedicated devlog. ;) But here's a preview of one of those exciting changes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/a0cc54ee977394188fe83a5418cae3e97858dfc8.gif

Telegraphing
Getting hit from behind? We’re enhancing telegraphing animations and effects to provide clearer cues in the heat of battle. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/5df295f4f274cb44eeab3db4d8a333c3571c892c.png

Graphics Upgrades / Explorations
Along with adding more details to the environment, we’re experimenting with shaders to give 13Z a more unique look that matches its theme. It’s still a work in progress but we’d love to hear what you think.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/602a3de291b28411862a147af0c025d94d5b5074.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/9aabb0fc92638c4005dd65cb64d7658d27018339.gif

We're also experimenting with water physics to make the environments more immersive. This will compliment Act 1’s various water features like the waterfalls and Gold Croak's level. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/9c90bfec244138f4f8d32ad07aa79a2193914928.gif

Handy QoL Tweaks
Features like camera lock and smoother targeting are on the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/999b223e32c59748d5bb3995aa1a5f26b73777c9.gif

New Key Art Sneak Peek 
We've also heard you asking about more info on the 12 Zodiacs—and we’re on it! We’re working on new key art that gives them a bigger spotlight. It’s super early, and some of the headshots are more playful than serious (our artist was having fun, lol), but we wanted to give the community a better sneak peek into 13Z's universe. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/e3b14754268f9dac0fec3193fb0a4d874309988f.png

About the Next Playtest Update
We’re fully diving into co-op mode development, along with some new mechanics. We’re targeting Q1 2025 for the big Co-op Playtest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/4d9e934702c0c2efa179b9513aec06603dca3e2a.gif

But you don’t need to wait that long to play an updated version of the current single-player playtest. We’ll be releasing another patch soon. However, some of the bigger changes mentioned above won’t make it into this upcoming patch just yet, as the co-op and single-player builds are on different tracks, and transferring all new mechanics would break the game.

We don’t have a specific date for this update yet, but we’re targeting to release it before the end of the year. Here’s what you can expect:

 Camera/Target Lock – Yep, it’s finally on the way!
 Enhanced VFX – A little extra flash never hurts.
 New Visuals for Lyra – We’ve made some tweaks to bring out her character more; we’ll showcase more sneak-peeks on our Discord. 

Community Updates
On Discord, we’ve added some fresh stickers and emojis for you to play with, and we’re cooking up a few more! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/c1c8e0d1406b9041a91953b07c7a81e675f2017a.gif

Also, here’s the very first fanart of Lyra courtesy of the talented Booey! If you've made fanart of 13Z, we’d love to see it—share it on our Discord, and don't forget to tag us on X (@13Z_game) so we don’t miss it. ;)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/6bdc0705bc5ac300da16a5cd77ffe2c34162d62a.jpg

Thanks for being with us and sharing your feedback! We’re excited to be building 13Z together with you!

Chat with us on: Discord | Twitter | Tiktok

Crafted with Love,
Mixed Realms Team

notes.title: 13Z Global Playtest is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey Zodiac Challengers, welcome to the very first Global Playtest for 13Z!

We just cracked open the doors to the Zodiac Trials, giving you an early sneak peek at our hack-and-slash action roguelike game inspired by the legend of the 12 Eastern Zodiacs. Step into the challenge and help us shape the adventure with your feedback and suggestions.

Watch the Global Playtest Trailer here:
[previewyoutube=qGbr89YknL0;full][/previewyoutube]

While co-op isn’t available in this build yet, please share 13Z with your friends—the more feedback we receive, the better we can fine-tune the game. If you're excited about what you see, be sure to wishlist 13Z too! :)

Now, let’s dive into what you can expect in this playtest build!

What Awaits You in the Global Playtest
Take on the first act of the Zodiac Trials as one of the challengers gunning for the 13th Zodiac spot:  Lyra the Fox also known as the Peerless Sword.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/33b771c3d4259017e0f7067a2a161cac3e15009d.gif

Unleash your unique abilities, boosted with upgrades and elemental powers collected along the way, as you tackle hordes of enemies. Face off against two formidable mini-bosses and gear up for the ultimate battle against the Goat Zodiac in the Act’s thrilling final showdown! If you stumble, don’t worry—there’s a welcoming village to nurse your spirits, so you can return to the trials stronger than ever!

Meet Your Adversaries
The trials are not just about endurance and strength—they’re about strategy and skill. Practice your ‘perfect dodge’ against the heavy-hitting Gronks or show off your aerial combat prowess against the flying Cursed Lanterns. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/54f1612f336c6569f2d65fe32ae8fecb4ff27fda.gif
Each enemy is designed to test a different aspect of your combat skills. But beyond these common foes, be prepared for more daunting battles ahead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/5fd2e7b9f87e7be4080f9d9c121148f1ce23fe56.jpg
Goldcroak the Guardian of Day and Treasures, lurking within the waterfalls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/525a70b50a66a828c472adbe53b981e2fc4ff753.jpg
The Moth Queen, the Night Guardian, casting whirlwinds with her relentless wings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/39a63836ff269aa0f6a698bbdb9f59d7a42786f4.gif
The formidable Goat Zodiac, commanding his flurry of sheeps and barraging you with flying spears in the Act’s final battle.

Upgrades and Power-Ups
Your journey through the Zodiac Trials isn’t just fraught with peril but opportunities for growth and power. Some upgrades appear upon clearing a level while pretty nifty perks are unlocked as permanent rewards for your past efforts in trying to beat the trials. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/526845ad307caab54b119fb2dd2d600e7e0e261b.gif
Elemental Scrolls: These are tied to elements that enhance your skills. While there will be more elemental choices in the future, the current playtest features the first three—Fire, Water, and Lightning—each with its own unique effect. Imagine leaving a trail of lightning with every dash, or summoning a fire spirit after executing your Special move. It’s your call!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/ee2dadd772e58466378c630f59c44a6db859014a.gif
Anvils: Customize your skills's attributes to better suit your play style. One of this dev’s favorite anvil upgrades is Falling Willows combined with the Secondary attack! ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/d60c0c37bb6c8ce93a1720623ed5525a0d2650ef.jpg
Blessings: As you prove your worth, the 12 Zodiac Guardians may bestow blessings upon you… for a price. 

Whether you aim for brute strength, agility, or strategic control, dive in and discover what works best for you!

Turtle Village: Your Sanctuary Between Trials
If the trials knock you down, Turtle Village is where you stand back up to chill until you’re ready to jump back into the fray.

You’ll discover intriguing side quests, bump into future challengers like the Raven and Panda who aren’t quite ready to join the trials just yet and unlock permanent upgrades at the Cultivation Tree using Jade earned from your past attempts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/63048a32481abe6cd81ad815c4be34298b62a123.jpg
You’ll be greeted by Fu Xi, the volunteer custodian of the makeshift village. He’s cleverly created variants of his likeness to maintain order as we await the arrival of all the Guardians. Don’t be fooled by his youthful looks and demeanor—rumor has it he’s at least 500 years old!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/781d3d09ffed3340031cbacb16b50725aaeb470c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/07315ffe13215263ebdf2876bc7d694d587d677e.jpg

Why is the village named Turtle Village? While we can’t spill all the secrets just yet, venturing beyond its bounds might give you some intriguing clues… ;)

Looking Ahead: The Road to Full Release
This playtest is just the beginning. You're getting a firsthand look at our work in progress, complete with some placeholders and the occasional bugs. Apart from overall polish, here's what's on the horizon for the full game:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/441d10abc4fc92ba838ce3c4f72779f318211a4f.png

 A deeper roguelike experience with more impactful builds and meaningful choices; 
 More playable characters;
 Co-op mode;
 Three more Acts, each set in unique landscapes guarded by their own Zodiac Guardians;
 A bustling village, full of new NPCs and quests to discover between Trials;
 More elements, skills, and abilities to experiment with!
 Game balancing and combat mechanics will be prioritized to enhance the overall player experience.

Share your Feedback
We truly value your insights and suggestions at this stage, so please don't hesitate to share them with us. Along with the in-game survey, our detailed feedback form below offers more questions and space for you to freely express your thoughts and comments.

ːexcited_gqːFEEDBACK FORM: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScZRxXF2KrOoFn-zVi6TgMg2SY3jnVDzD6RdL_gQ6aW8fBPjw/viewform


Spread the Word and Stay Connected
Sharing 13Z with friends and adding it to your wishlist are great ways to support our team. Every bit counts as we continue to build this game with the community. Chat with us on: Discord | Twitter | Tiktok

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348250/13Z/

Thank you for joining us, and we hope you’ll enjoy your first dive into the world of 13Z.
Now, let the Zodiac Trials begin!

Craft with Love,
Mixed Realms

notes.title: Devlog #02: Meet the First Zodiac Challenger - Lyra the Fox!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/d8d1002682b78e59bfff1929a79cbf7349506446.png

Hey Zodiac Challengers!

Welcome to Devlog #02 for 13Z. If you recall, in our last post, we shared what 13Z stands for - the 13th Zodiac. We talked about the inspirations behind the game.

We also introduced the 13Z's premise: incumbent eastern Zodiac guardians searching for a new animal to join their ranks.

Today, we're thrilled to introduce the first animal challenger vying for the coveted 13th zodiac spot: Lyra the Fox. Join us as we delve into Lyra's backstory, explore her design evolution, and showcase her incredible abilities.

Watch our full devlog:

[previewyoutube=MDt1v6LQcZI;full][/previewyoutube]
Hailing from a prestigious clan of swordswomen, Lyra has always been a free spirit. Rather than conforming to her family's expectations of becoming an ordinary martial artist, she's chosen to forge her own path by entering the Zodiac Trials.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/4a6894987a0260a8b55e6fa22380bd316e16d220.gif

Lyra's rebellious nature and distinct traits inspired our initial sketches, leading to various designs that aimed to capture her essence. We grappled with questions like: Should we give her her big ears, bushy tail, or both?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/b34bc85e11f924baf79476addc5430381a3f12e2.png
Early on, we conducted polls on social media to gather your opinions. Using this feedback, we refined Lyra's look through multiple iterations, balancing her character traits with our fantasy art style.

To enhance player customization, we've created different color themes for Lyra, allowing you to personalize her outfit and truly make her your own.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/198abaa08cbc3823fb2ae1342a1fa2746d54132c.gif

Lyra's Combat Prowess & Abilities

In battle, Lyra is a formidable opponent. Her primary attacks unleash a flurry of rapid slashes and a wide tail swing, perfect for cutting through waves of enemies with agility and precision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/b821ede7b21015cab5920304b55d38fb56af8cba.gif

Her secondary attack, a powerful upward slash, sends foes airborne, turning aerial combat into an art form. The combo ends with a swift and devastating spiral slash, delivering a forceful, twirling finale.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/9d6a57433e377324ee065626cddd3ed36127037c.gif

When the heat of battle intensifies, unleash Lyra's special ability: a dazzling barrage of phantom blade attacks that will leave hordes of opponents reeling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/1ac7589d1f11eb8036661c5d2caed2f5cf1fa2a8.gif

True to her vulpine nature, Lyra can transform into a fox, allowing her to evade enemy attacks in the blink of an eye or scale high places in the maps. Advanced players can even use this transformation offensively, diving into enemies to deal damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/dc53009311df1cf8ebcbd711b5cec79942560ca9.gif

As you progress, you'll unlock more abilities and builds, allowing you to tailor Lyra's growth to your preferred playstyle, ensuring each run feels fresh and exciting.

Exciting News: Upcoming Global Playtest!

We're thrilled to announce that we will be hosting a global playtest soon, and Lyra the Fox will be a playable character! You'll also face off against one of the twelve Zodiac guardians in an epic boss fight, giving you a taste of 13Z's fluid combat system and stunning visual style.

To be among the first to know when the playtest drops, join our Discord community. Stay connected through our social channels below for all the latest updates.

We can't wait to hear your thoughts on Lyra and 13Z. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to refine and perfect the game.

Twitter | Discord | Tiktok

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348250/13Z/

Don’t forget to add 13Z to your wishlist, spread the word to your friends, and help us bring this game to life! 

Thank you for joining us on this journey. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those swords sharp, Challengers!

notes.title: Devlog #1: The Inspirations Behind 13Z
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/06f4fae7c949a45d2832602c55086185b27cf3fe.jpg
Hey Zodiac Challengers!

Welcome to our first devlog for 13Z where we take you behind the scenes to explore the quirky origins, inspirations and some future plans for our game. 

It All Started With.. Cats
Believe it or not, we originally wanted to create a cat-themed action game because we've got a few cat lovers and pawrents in the team!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/54b48f7a302246c45ed56b57a252b78a38b14a67.png
During one of our brainstorming sessions, a fascinating tidbit came up: the cat was famously left out of the Eastern Zodiac circle due to mythic rivalries and celestial twists of fate. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/b01fa94b46f0a6cf849c0528e79ea735cf15425a.png
For those unfamiliar with the Eastern Zodiac, it comprises twelve animals—Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, and Pig—each governing a year in a 12-year cycle. These animals significantly influence the personalities and destinies of individuals born in their respective years. Unlike the Western Zodiac, which is based on monthly divisions and celestial constellations, the Eastern Zodiac assigns a year-long period to each sign, integrating both cosmic and earthly elements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/15f0f4244f811c974def599e4cfbd311f9f90031.jpg
Intrigued by the legend, we thought: what if there was a 13th Zodiac? And what if it was a cat? What if this was a game about the incumbent Zodiac guardians looking for a new animal to join their ranks?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/454f9f06f4d330354fd6309796abe09e3fa44156.jpg
This idea quickly grew legs - or rather, paws. As we deliberated, our Chief Happiness Officer, a lovable cavapoodle, looked up at us with big, soulful eyes. In that moment of cuteness overload, we thought, "Why stop at cats? Why not include other animals too?" One thing led to another, and our Zodiac game expanded to encompass a whole array of animal spirits.

But you might ask - why is our first character not a cat but a fox? Well, that's a tail… we mean tale… for another time. ;)

Our Vision for 13Z

13Z is a bold blend of oriental mythology and whimsical fantasy that places our studio's love for fast-paced, stylish and fluid action at its core.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/749c09a2e34e6173fc8b976b693d4a4d93543ef0.gif

Beyond grounded combat, we're also focusing on choreographing moves that make use of the level verticality and aerial combos. Yes, we're huge fans of DMC. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/1d219774e3ba019cb74ac55da18c6acf067f2393.gif

Our character designs and concepts are another area that we're thrilled about. Each Challenger has unique skills, with some able to transform into their spirit animal forms as part of their combat abilities.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/0cf22b4232f5ca054eee20dc24e6ffa75c7de5a5.gif

We believe a great game is best enjoyed with friends, so co-op will be a key feature of 13Z. Players can find synergistic builds with their teams to tackle challenges together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/9b71e18de70a46d3f152ede7f0822928a8fd7f16.gif

Though not shown in our early gameplay video, we're also working on a village that players can upgrade to enhance their abilities in future runs, while interacting with NPCs and fulfilling some side quests. We’ll share more details about this once the mechanics are finalized, but it's an area we're very excited about.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/fc9be5deca5d6c3b573367348468cb4ffc6f7567.jpg
Finally, as with any great roguelike experience, variety and choices matter. We're working on synergistic upgrade systems within and outside of the Trials to design satisfying progression paths for different characters and builds.

Permanent upgrades can also be unlocked using persistent currencies earned from the Trials. From new skills and characters to Village upgrades and run modifiers, these persistent improvements will enhance your strategies and keep each attempt fresh and exciting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/504ef74b86d3d2c688926448150dcfcc92ba8edd.png

That's right, Challengers! We're currently crafting a demo of 13Z as we'd love for the community to have a meaningful part to play in building a game that we would all want to play together. Expect to see it in a few months—we can't wait to share our progress and hear your thoughts.

If you'd like to be one of the first to know or to be part of our closed demo, please join us on Discord.

Stay connected and share your feedback through our social channels. 

Twitter | Discord | Tiktok

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348250/13Z/

Don’t forget to add 13Z to your wishlist, tell your friends and help us bring 13Z to life!

Thank you for joining us on our journey!

Crafted with Love,
Mixed Realms

notes.title: Welcome to 13Z!
notes.content:
Hi Zodiac Challengers!

We’d like to take this opportunity to thank all of you for your support since our soft announcement last week. Sharing our early gameplay trailer on Twitter was just a small glimpse into what we’re crafting, and we never expected the traction we received from the community—thank you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/b42f4f21c7653479f79897a0b40b29751688a5a9.png
A Peek into 13Z
[previewyoutube=ghAcRUnlWZ0;full][/previewyoutube]
While the trailer only showcased snippets of our vision, rest assured there's a LOT more to come. For example, we’re currently working on the concepts for one of the first Zodiac Guardians (boss). 🤫 We’re also finalizing the designs of the environment and the Raven. Please stay tuned for more updates soon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/31eaf96f01d011c90643cc0830a5dbf1cd17ac27.png
Frequently Asked Questions
We’d also like to answer some of the most commonly asked questions we’ve received so far -

Will there be a demo?
Yes! We're working on a private demo to give you a taste of the action ahead of the full game. We’ll make the announcement once we’re ready to invite playtesters!

Is the gameplay for single-player or multiplayer?
The game will support both single-player and co-op modes, allowing up to four players to challenge the Zodiac Trials together.

How many Challengers will there be all in all?
We are planning to introduce up to 6 Challengers at full launch. Fox, Raven and Panda are confirmed at this point.

If the game is about the 12 Zodiacs, why weren't they in the video?
We are in the process of designing the 12 Zodiac bosses. Each will have a unique role, some aiding the players, while others ensure a formidable challenge.

Will this game be available on VR, too?
Nothing concrete yet but it’s something we are seriously considering. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/26a24e812fbf1b1af58424c626a4f6a439f1c105.png
We're still early in the development of 13Z, but what you've seen so far—early gameplay and our initial concepts—marks an exciting phase. This is when we get to open up about our work and really dive into building the game with your input, which has always been at the heart of how we like to do things as a studio.

Which Key Art Attracts You More? 

For starters, we’d love to hear your thoughts on our Key Art. While we plan to include more characters in the future, we’re curious to know what catches your attention more as a player—something plain and bright, or a design with a more detailed background? Your vote will help guide our design decisions. :) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/81285f01423854a0fd551dbc5bdb29b4b330f65c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/83cc13f8b90273ccb650597155c78f504027b747.png
Also, join us on Discord to get a more behind-the-scenes look at our progress. We'll be rolling out new polls soon as we continue to reveal more about the game. We're excited to shape 13Z together with you!

Connect with Us

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out to us through our social channels below. We love engaging with our community.

Twitter | Discord | Tiktok

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348250/13Z/

And last but not least, if you haven't already, please consider adding 13Z to your wishlist on Steam and share it with your friends :) It would really mean a lot to us. 

Thank you for joining us on our journey!

Crafted with Love,
Mixed Realms
